settings.headline: Build Your Own Rakhi Gift Hamper
settings.description: Make this Raksha Bandhan extra special. Build a custom hamper filled with gourmet sweets, healthy nuts, dry fruits, puja thali, and premium artisanal thread rakhis.

settings.title: Select the Thread
settings.subtext: Choose from our catalog of rural-weaver handcrafted designer Rakhis.

settings.title: Add Sweets & Delicacies
settings.subtext: Add pure-ghee Kaju Katli, Motichoor Ladoos, roasted almonds, or premium chocolates.

settings.title: Include Pooja Elements
settings.subtext: Every hamper automatically includes traditional Roli and Chawal packets in handmade boxes.

settings.title: Write a Gift Card
settings.subtext: Add a customized personal message which we will print on our gold-leaf scroll card.
